mapper.select: SELECT environment_history_id, plan_id, measured_at, temperature, humidity, co2, radiation, light, soil_temperature, soil_moisture, soil_ec, soil_ph FROM greenhouse_environment_history WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY measured_at DESC, environment_history_id DESC LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO greenhouse_environment_history ( plan_id, measured_at, temperature, humidity, co2, radiation, light, soil_temperature, soil_moisture, soil_ec, soil_ph ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{measuredAt}, #{temperature}, #{humidity}, #{co2}, #{radiation}, #{light}, #{soilTemperature}, #{soilMoisture}, #{soilEc}, #{soilPh} );
